adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicEmbed.import` deliberately and silently returns `nil` for any URL not matching `/^https?\:\/\//` (`return unless url =~ ...`), and there is even a spec asserting this behavior (`returns nil when the URL is malformed`). In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, `url` is set from `i.link` and then possibly replaced by `i.id` when blank/invalid; if both are blank/nil (or `i.id` is still non-http/relative), `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, ...)` will be called with `nil`/invalid and will silently no-op with no logging. That’s a real, diff-grounded observability/edge-case issue (items can be dropped without any trace), but it’s not clearly a defect since the silent-nil behavior is intentional per the added test.
